description: AC.M5D.4 — Retroactive blind PPL (Prospective Prediction Log) entries for the 5 domain-mapped held-out LEL events. Predictions generated from fitted DBN parameters (dbn_params_v1_0.json) only; event outcomes not consulted before prediction entry (blind retroactive protocol per LEL_HELD_OUT_PARTITION_v1_0.md §4 + PPL_RETROACTIVE_PROTOCOL_v1_0.md). CI format per NAP.M5.3 (90% HDI, asymmetric). Wide marginal HDI [0.013–0.947] is epistemically correct: reflects state-assignment uncertainty (mixture of SUPPRESSED/NORMAL/ELEVATED components). Point estimate = mixture mean; component-level HDIs in `component_observation_posteriors` are more interpretively useful (per NAP.M5.3 §6).
n1_caveat: Marginal 90% HDI is computed via Monte Carlo mixture sampling (300k draws, seed=42). The wide interval [0.013–0.947] reflects genuine model uncertainty about domain state assignment — not poor fit. The component-level HDIs (e.g., CAREER ELEVATED: [0.709–0.958] from Beta(18,3)) are the tighter, more informative intervals. SUPPRESSED state (Beta(0.5,9.5), prior-anchored) contributes low-probability mass that widens the lower tail. 4 of 9 held-out events skipped (loss/other — no DBN domain).
